properties.name: Masinga Dam
properties.note: Largest storage reservoir; regulates the whole cascade. Spill at full supply level ~1,056.5 m a.s.l.

properties.name: Gitaru Dam
properties.note: Highest-output station of the cascade; small storage, spills fast.

properties.name: Kindaruma Dam
properties.note: Oldest dam of the cascade; minimal storage.

properties.name: Kiambere Dam
properties.note: Last dam; releases enter the free-flowing lower Tana toward Garissa.
